ns2:section.sectionText: Fundamental concepts of entrepreneurship and commercialization of new technology in new and existing businesses. We explore entrepreneurship and innovating as a career path. Guest speaker topics vary, but typically include: evaluation of technologies and business ideas in general; financing through private and public sources; legal issues; product development; marketing; international business issues; sustainable innovations. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 2 hours, if topics vary; instructor approval required. For undergraduate students only. This section is restricted to Living-Learning Community (LLC) residents.
